title: Aprea Therapeutics Announces a Partial Clinical Hold on Myeloid Malignancy Programs
description: BOSTON, Aug.  05, 2021  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aprea Therapeutics, Inc. The partial clinical hold does not apply to the Company’s ongoing clinical trials in lymphoid malignancies and solid tumors, or the APR-548 clinical trial.
